steps.domain_action: prepare the quantum vacuum state, initializing the Hilbert space with no particles
introduce the classical measurement apparatus as the boundary that defines the observable basis
apply a unitary evolution operator to the initial state, generating a superposition
decompose the composite system (quantum system + apparatus) into its two subsystems: quantum state and apparatus pointer
the apparatus pointer registers a positive outcome that confirms the initial state preparation
recombine the two subsystems into the original product state via tensor product, recovering the initial composite state
perform a measurement collapse, projecting the superposition onto a single eigenstate
the measurement yields a result that does not match the prediction, indicating a deviation
maintain a coherent superposition of both measurement outcomes without resolving the ambiguity
compose the forward evolution with the measurement collapse, forming a sequential process
the quantum system identifies itself as the same vector in Hilbert space throughout the operation
record the final measurement outcome as a permanent classical bit in the memory register
